_about: Visuals generated with OpenArt (Wan 2.7 Image, 2K) in the Solix palette: navy #0D192D, red #EE2424, blue #0088CF. scripts/vendor-media.js copies each `url` to public/media/openart/<file> (run on deploy, or locally before committing), so pages serve them from this site. `video` is an optional looping clip (mp4/webm under public/media/openart/) that replaces the animated still when present. Assets marked `watermarked` are free-plan previews: the site does not load them and shows `fallback` instead. After exporting clean originals from a paid OpenArt plan, replace `url` and set `watermarked` to false.

archiving.prompt: Abstract 3D render: glowing blue data strands flowing from the left and compressing into stacked translucent glass archive tiers on the right, a thin red light line tracing the tiers, deep navy space, fine grid floor.

ai.prompt: Abstract 3D render: a luminous knowledge-graph constellation of blue nodes and filaments with a few red key nodes around a bright core, orbit rings and haze on deep navy.

governance.prompt: Abstract 3D render: stacked frosted-glass panes of data cells, some masked and tokenised, wrapped by a blue light shield arc with a red scanning line, hexagonal lattice on deep navy.

platform.prompt: Isometric 3D render: a modular stack of glass-and-metal platform slabs joined by blue data conduits, satellite region nodes linked by light arcs, one layer edged in red, grid ground plane on deep navy.

content.prompt: Abstract 3D render: an arc of translucent documents and emails fanning out of a stack, swept by a blue scanning beam that leaves highlight markers, a few documents lifted out and outlined in red, deep navy.

empower.prompt: Cinematic keynote stage for 'The Agentic Enterprise': audience silhouettes from behind facing a curved LED wall of glowing AI-agent networks, red and blue beams through haze, navy palette.
